original_content_full:
The paper "Dynamic Digital Twins: Challenges, Perspectives and Practical Implementation from a City's Perspective" by Rico Richter, Frank Knospe, Matthias Trapp, Jürgen Döllner was 
accepted for publication at the 18th 3DGeoInfo Conference (3DGeoInfo 2023). The conference will take place in Munich, Germamy from September 13rd to 14th. For more information, visit the website.
